{{Top|leg}}
'''Assistant Features Editor''' was a title within [[Colonial News Nets]], that was held by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pertaal Shenvehr]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a lowly position within the [[NewsNet]] and meant that Pertaal was responsible for writing various columns.
